summary: Iteration 2 of Resonate.Dubai LLC tested end-to-end. Backend: 10/10 pytest cases pass (health, reviews x8, vacancies public seeded incl. 'Taxi Driver — Sharjah', admin auth guard on /vacancies/all, admin create+delete vacancy propagates to public list, survey submit minimal + full, admin survey list, survey/upload). Frontend: services=5, team=5 (names match), clients=8, partners=7, footer address contains 'Compass Co-Working Space, Al Jazeera Al Hamra Industry'. Admin dashboard shows 3 tabs; vacancy add/delete + submission detail dialog all working via new data-testids. One CRITICAL survey submission bug found (empty email string causes 422). One broken team image (sobti.jpg) not present in /public/team/.

critical.issue: SurveyIn.email is Optional[EmailStr] but frontend always sends email='' (initial state) — pydantic rejects empty string with 422 'must have an @-sign'. Result: any user who does not fill the optional email cannot submit the survey. Playwright end-to-end submit reproduced 422. Repro: curl -X POST /api/survey/submit -d '{"name":"x","phone":"+91123","intent":"job","email":""}' → 422.

minor.issue: Endpoint only resolves paths stored on db.updates; passport files uploaded via /api/survey/upload are recorded in db.survey_uploads and are NOT downloadable via /api/files/. Admin detail dialog links to /api/files/{passport_front_path} which will 404. Fix: also look up survey_uploads (and/or surveys.passport_*_path) to authorise download.

ui_bugs.issue: Missing image /team/sobti.jpg (naturalWidth=0). Other 4 members render correctly. Fallback initials show but appears as broken vs real photo.

integration_issues.issue: Survey submit fails with 422 whenever the optional email field is left blank because the frontend defaults email='' and sends it as-is. Fix in frontend: strip empty strings before POST (or in backend: coerce '' → None via validator).

action_items: CRITICAL: Fix survey submit 422 when email is empty. Recommended: add a Pydantic field_validator on SurveyIn.email to convert empty string to None, OR strip empty optional strings in the frontend submit payload.
Add /public/team/sobti.jpg (or update Team.js to use fallback initials cleanly) — sobti.jpg currently 404s.
Extend /api/files/{path} lookup to include survey_uploads so admin can view uploaded passport files.
critical_code_review_comments: SurveyIn.email uses Optional[EmailStr] but no empty-string coercion — direct source of the 422 bug.
/api/files/{path:path} enforces auth-through-obscurity by requiring a matching updates record; it silently blocks legitimate passport downloads.
CORS is set with allow_origins='*' and allow_credentials=False in server.py — acceptable for public API but note if cookies are ever added.
server.py hits 550+ lines; consider splitting routers (auth, survey, vacancies, updates) into modules soon.

success_rate.frontend: ~85% (survey blocked by email 422 bug; all other flows verified)

seed_data_creation: Two TEST_ survey submissions created via API and one TEST_ vacancy add/delete via UI (deleted).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new v2 behaviours (5 services, 5 team, 8+7 clients/partners, footer address, vacancies CRUD, admin submissions detail dialog, survey 5-slide) are wired. The only blocker is the email='' 422 bug on /api/survey/submit — after fix, re-run backend_test.py and re-verify UI end-to-end survey submission with all-optional-blank flow.
rca of the issue: Frontend SurveyForm.js keeps `email: ''` in `initial` state and always sends the full `data` object to POST /api/survey/submit. Backend Pydantic model SurveyIn.email is `Optional[EmailStr] = None`. Pydantic v2 treats empty string '' as an invalid email (must contain @), so the endpoint returns 422 even though the field is optional. Two-line fix options: (a) backend — add `@field_validator('email', mode='before') def _empty_to_none(v): return v or None`; (b) frontend — before submit, `Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(data).filter(([_,v]) => v !== ''))`. Recommend the backend fix as it also guards against similar issues for other optional string fields sent as ''.
